title: Final Wave Function
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct form of the ground-state wave function, including its dependence on the parameters a and k.

title: Energy Eigenvalue Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive and present the equation relating k to the parameters g, m, and h-bar.

title: Parity Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention that the wave function has even parity due to the symmetry of the potential.

title: Continuity Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must state the continuity condition at x = a for the wave function.

title: Normalization Step
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the normalization condition for the wave function and how it leads to determining the constant B.

title: Discontinuity Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention the discontinuity condition for the derivative of the wave function at x = a.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes when deriving the energy eigenvalue relation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all terms in the equations are dimensionally consistent.
